scope.slice: public artifact, bundle, run, sample, and recorded-event identity foundation

coverage: recomputed hashes cannot bind an edited Core to a stale Business revision
nested Plan type, stable identity, and reference corruption is rejected
lineage fingerprints and symbol tables are revalidated rather than trusted
cyclic, non-JSON, wrong-slot, ABM, and production inputs are structured and isolated
repeated seeds retain distinct run and sample identity
filtered event IDs remain stable and foreign sample references are rejected
caller-rehashed run and event reports cannot upgrade execution, trigger, mapping, or coverage evidence
Summary, absent trace, truncation, and unresolved references report evidence insufficiency

resolved_during_review: forged but rehashed lineage, run evidence, event identity, trigger, and coverage claims were accepted too broadly
Plan-only inspection and run identity accepted malformed nested layout values and references
Summary and absent-trace projections did not share the resolvable evidence-insufficient shape
foreign sample references and filtered-row-derived identity needed explicit stable handling
hostile cyclic and wrong-layer inputs needed structured failure instead of exception escape

accepted_claims: persisted aircraft Business, Core, Plan, and lineage artifacts have a public versioned offline inspection boundary
a Plan association is claimed only after supplied raw layers and lineage relationships are revalidated
independent Core inspection is supported without reconstructing or guessing a Business layer
run and recorded-event references preserve stable sample identity and disclose incomplete evidence
residual_boundaries: Issues 10 and 11 remain open; SysML export and runtime collection/query are not implemented by this slice
content digests are consistency checks, not signatures or authenticated execution provenance
coarse aircraft compatibility operations provide partial rule coverage only
resource_dispatch_index identity validation is explicitly unsupported in v1
ABM and production artifacts are isolated but do not receive complete identity or trace support
there is no new Rust identity API, runtime instrumentation, scheduler, RNG, observation-default, or performance claim
conclusion: No remaining blocker was found within the declared first-slice contract. The implementation is suitable for an independent review PR while issues 10 and 11 remain open for later export and collection/query slices.
